items.title: Richard Brunies Interview, 1959-04-27
items.q: This ain't Henny Bernis, you know. His wife.

ctx.x: Could you give us your exact birth date? We'd like to have all that. I'm born in 1889, November 29. Could you tell us a little bit about your father? I don't even know his first name except Mr. Brunus.

Well, my father, he was the leader of our little junior band we had. His name was? And his name was Henry Brunus. Henry, too. Yeah. And he had my sister playing guitar. One of my other brothers playing guitar. He had to wait for him out. My brother Rudy playing guitar. And little Henny had to stand on a chair to play string bass. And I was the only one that didn't play anything. So my dad used to take us around to places on Saturday nights when he got through. He's White Baker. He was a baker. And he brought us…
His right name was Phillips, but they used to give him that name Fisher. Fisher. He's dead now. Well, it wasn't his real name. No, Phillips.
